verdict.rationale: The evidence pack for Shopify Agentic Commerce covers UCP protocol capabilities — catalog search, cart/checkout MCP servers, order tracking, webhooks, profiles/trust tiers — all aimed at letting AI agents transact on behalf of buyers. None of it describes AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to a user from their own data inside the product (e.g., analytics, business intelligence, or recommendations derived from store/customer data). This is a fair question for a commerce platform, but no evidence supports it here.
